topic.name: 美国政策与全球影响
topic.description: 关注美国政治、外交、经济政策及其国际外溢效应

overview: 今日专题“美国政策与全球影响”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Trump’s ‘retribution’ could now include Falklands as favor to Milei – and revenge on the UK
items.summary: US president suggests he might support his Argentinian acolyte’s drive to reclaim sovereignty of disputed islands Donald Trump has long embraced vengeance. “I am your retribution,” he declared to an admiring audience at the 2023 Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) as he commenced his march back to the White House. It is unlikely Argentina, and far-flung holdovers of the former British empire, were on the US president’s mind at the time. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 特朗普的“报复”可能包括将马尔维纳斯群岛作为对米莱的恩惠，并以此报复英国
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普暗示可能支持阿根廷对马尔维纳斯群岛的主权主张。此举被视为其对阿根廷总统米莱的支持，同时也可能被解读为对英国的某种报复。
items.whyImportant: 若美国改变对马岛主权争议的立场，将对英美特殊关系及南美地缘政治产生重大冲击。

items.title: Colombia president provokes disgust by posing with bodies of ‘terrorists’
items.summary: Abelardo De La Espriella posts video of himself with rows of body bags as performative populism continues to sweep Americas Colombia’s hardline president, Abelardo De La Espriella, has provoked outrage after posting a video on social media in which he strides through rows of white body bags that he says contained the corpses of 23 “neutralised” guerrillas. De La Espriella took power last month vowing “all-out war” against illegal armed groups and he published the footage on Thursday in an apparent attempt to show he was fulfilling that pledge. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 哥伦比亚总统与“恐怖分子”尸体合影引发厌恶
items.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯皮耶拉在社交媒体发布视频，展示其走过23具被“消灭”的游击队员尸体。此举旨在展示其履行打击非法武装团体的承诺，但引发了公众的强烈抗议。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了美洲地区民粹主义政治风格的激进化趋势，引发了关于政治领导人行为准则的伦理争议。

items.title: How US military presence spurred Pattaya’s rise into Thailand’s city of pleasure
items.summary: The Amazon deliveries stopped reaching the USS Abraham Lincoln in February as it entered the conflict zone with Iran. A few weeks later – much to the chagrin of the sailors on board – even that most American of meals, the hamburger, was compromised by supply shortages when burger buns ran out. But as they unwind on their first shore leave in 286 days, the 5,000 crew of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier are finding out what tens of thousands of their forebears already knew: Pattaya will...

items.titleZh: 美国军事存在如何推动芭堤雅成为泰国的“享乐之城”
items.summaryZh: 在海上执行任务近300天后，美国“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航母的5000名船员抵达芭堤雅进行休整。芭堤雅作为美军长期以来的度假胜地，其城市发展深受美军消费和文化的影响。
items.whyImportant: 文章探讨了军事部署与当地旅游经济及社会文化演变之间的长期历史联系。

items.title: Lunar Occultation of Venus
items.summary: On Wednesday, June 17, skywatchers across the United States—and parts of Canada—enjoyed a rare event: a daytime lunar occultation of Venus. A lunar occultation occurs when the Moon moves directly in front of another celestial object from our viewpoint on Earth, briefly hiding it from sight. This time, the Moon slipped in front of Venus […]

items.titleZh: 月掩金星天象
items.summaryZh: 6月17日，美国和加拿大等地的天文爱好者观测到了一次罕见的白昼月掩金星现象。当月球运行至地球与金星之间时，金星被月球短暂遮挡。
items.whyImportant: 这是一次重要的天文观测事件，为科学研究和公众科普提供了难得的机会。

items.title: South Korea weighs ‘contributions’ to Hormuz as US pressure mounts
items.summary: South Korea is moving towards the possible deployment of naval assets to the Strait of Hormuz under mounting pressure from Washington, potentially making it one of the first US allies to contribute militarily to the strategically vital waterway, observers have said. The government has reportedly drawn up plans to deploy military assets, including a naval logistics support ship and P-8A maritime patrol aircraft, to the strait. If carried out, the deployment would mark South Korea’s first dispatch...
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 在美方压力下，韩国考虑向霍尔木兹海峡派遣军事力量
items.summaryZh: 受美国压力影响，韩国正计划向霍尔木兹海峡派遣海军后勤支援舰和海上巡逻机。若计划实施，这将是韩国首次向该战略要地派遣军事资产。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着韩国在地区安全事务中可能采取更积极的军事参与姿态，并可能影响其与中东及美国的关系。

items.title: Blasts at Bolivian military base kill at least 10, injure dozens
items.summary: Authorities say seven people are still missing after deadly explosions at a facility storing pyrotechnic material.
items.titleZh: 玻利维亚一军事基地发生爆炸，造成至少10人死亡，数十人受伤
items.summaryZh: 当局表示，在一处储存烟火材料的设施发生致命爆炸后，仍有七人失踪。救援工作正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 此次爆炸事故造成了严重的人员伤亡，引发了对军事设施安全管理的关注。

items.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
items.summary: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.
items.titleZh: 玻利维亚一军事营地发生爆炸，至少两人死亡
items.summaryZh: 当局担心维亚查（Viacha）的死亡人数会进一步上升。由于存在后续爆炸风险，民众已被警告远离该营地。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了军事设施周边地区的安全隐患及潜在的次生灾害风险。

items.title: Sydney set to hit 33C in potentially warmest start to spring since mid-1800s, while snow forecast in southern NSW
items.summary: A total fire ban is in place for greater Sydney with extreme fire danger exacerbated by hot and windy conditions Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Summer heat is due to arrive early across much of eastern Australia with potentially record early September temperatures predicted for Brisbane and Sydney, while snow was expected in southern New South Wales. Maximum temperatures in Sydney during the first days of September were on track to match the city’s midsummer average of 26.4C, warmer than any other start to spring since the city’s Observatory Hill station opened in 1858. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 悉尼气温预计将达33摄氏度，或迎19世纪中期以来最热春季开端，新南威尔士州南部则有降雪预报
items.summaryZh: 悉尼已发布全面禁火令，极端高温和大风天气加剧了火灾风险。与此同时，澳大利亚东部多地气温异常偏高，而新南威尔士州南部部分地区却预计出现降雪。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气模式的并存反映了气候变化对澳大利亚季节性气候的显著影响。

items.title: How much can Canada fight back in its trade war with the US?
items.summary: The US may be the bigger trading partner, but Canada shouldn't be counted out quite yet in the escalating trade fight.
items.titleZh: 加拿大在与美国的贸易战中能有多少反击能力？
items.summaryZh: 尽管美国是加拿大更大的贸易伙伴，但在不断升级的贸易争端中，加拿大仍具备一定的应对能力。分析人士正在评估其反制手段的有效性。
items.whyImportant: 加美贸易关系的紧张态势对北美经济稳定及双边政策走向具有重要影响。

items.title: Australia’s housing prices are trending down. See which suburbs have had the biggest falls
items.summary: Cotality says prices have declined in most capital cities over winter. Search the data to see how they have changed in your area Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australia’s property market is facing a rare price correction, as rising interest rates and less favourable tax settings for investors accelerate a downturn. Most capital cities recorded winter price falls, according to Cotality data, with Sydney leading the decline. That weakness is expected to continue, as higher inflation could lead to further interest rate hikes, denting demand. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚房价呈下降趋势，查看哪些郊区跌幅最大
items.summaryZh: 数据显示，受利率上升和投资者税收政策调整影响，澳大利亚多数首府城市冬季房价出现下跌。悉尼领跌，且由于通胀压力可能导致进一步加息，市场疲软态势预计将持续。
items.whyImportant: 房地产市场的价格调整反映了宏观经济政策对居民财富和消费能力的直接冲击。

items.title: Deadly escalation in Black Sea attacks prompts fears of even higher food prices
items.summary: Russian and Ukrainian strikes in July killed more crew than in whole war to that month, preventing grain exports A summer of hostilities in the Black Sea proved deadly for seafarers, as Russia and Ukraine attacked each other’s ships and port infrastructure, preventing vital grain exports and prompting concerns that the conflict will push global food prices even higher. More crew were killed in the Black Sea in July than during the entirety of the war before that month as the conflict has intensified, making the body of water the most dangerous in the world for commercial shipping. This is despite the conflict between the US and Iran, with vessels still being targeted in the strait of Hormuz, Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 黑海袭击事件升级引发对食品价格进一步上涨的担忧
items.summaryZh: 俄乌双方在黑海的军事冲突导致7月份船员死亡人数激增，严重阻碍了粮食出口。黑海已成为全球商业航运最危险的区域，引发了对全球食品价格上涨的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 黑海航运安全受阻直接威胁全球粮食供应链，可能加剧国际通胀压力。

items.title: Outrage as Maltese tycoon acquitted in journalist's murder
items.summary: Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of complicity to murder journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Almost nine years after the attack, the question of who ordered her death remains unanswered.
items.titleZh: 马耳他大亨被判谋杀记者罪名不成立，引发众怒
items.summaryZh: 马耳他商人尤尔根·费内奇被判谋杀记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚的共谋罪名不成立。在袭击发生近九年后，谁是幕后主使依然成谜。
items.whyImportant: 此判决引发了公众对司法公正和新闻自由保护的广泛质疑。

items.title: Repeated attacks on humanitarian warehouses put vital medical aid at risk in Ukraine: WHO
items.summary: A new airstrike overnight damaged one of the main warehouses used by the World Health Organization (WHO) in Ukraine to store humanitarian medical supplies in the Kyiv region, the UN agency said on Friday.
items.titleZh: 世卫组织：乌克兰人道主义仓库屡遭袭击，重要医疗援助面临风险
items.summaryZh: 世界卫生组织表示，基辅地区的一处主要人道主义医疗物资仓库在夜间空袭中受损。此类袭击严重威胁了当地医疗援助的供应能力。
items.whyImportant: 针对人道主义设施的袭击阻碍了战区医疗救助工作，加剧了当地的人道主义危机。

items.title: Death on the road to Rafah: the night the IDF targeted World Central Kitchen aid workers
items.summary: The Israeli army had helped plan the delivery of food aid on 1 April 2024, but things went wrong from the beginning and ended in seven deaths • Exclusive: why seven international aid workers were killed in Israeli airstrike On the evening of 1 April 2024, a team of aid workers from World Central Kitchen (WCK) stood on Gaza’s Mediterranean shore overseeing the unloading of a barge full of desperately needed food on a makeshift jetty made of sand and rubble. The Gaza war had been raging for six months and Israel’s closure of land crossings had left the whole territory facing the threat of famine. WCK and local Palestinian contractors had constructed the jetty out of everything they could lay their hands on, including debris from the bombed house of one of the contractors, so that the pallets of humanitarian assistance could be delivered by boat from Cyprus. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 拉法之路上的死亡：以色列国防军袭击世界中央厨房救援人员之夜
items.summaryZh: 2024年4月1日，尽管以色列军队参与了食品援助交付的规划，但行动最终导致七名世界中央厨房的救援人员丧生。这些救援人员当时正在加沙海岸监督通过临时码头卸载人道主义物资。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了国际社会对加沙地带人道主义救援安全及以色列军事行动透明度的严重关切。

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
items.summary: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基称俄罗斯无人机袭击乌克兰安全总部
items.summaryZh: 一架无人驾驶飞行器在乌克兰首都中心地带发动了突袭。目前暂无更多细节披露。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击显示乌克兰首都的安全局势依然脆弱，且俄乌冲突持续升级。

items.title: Taiwan’s opposition parties split over mayoral race, threatening 2028 election alliance
items.summary: A rupture between Taiwan’s two opposition parties over a mayoral race threatens to spill into November’s elections and erode the fragile trust underpinning their potential 2028 alliance. The main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and smaller Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) have both registered candidates for mayor of Zhubei, the biggest city in Hsinchu county, after weeks of negotiations failed to produce a joint contender. The KMT has nominated Hsinchu county councillor Wu Hsu-chih, while the TPP’s Chiu...
items.titleZh: 台湾反对党在市长选举中分裂，威胁到2028年选举联盟
items.summaryZh: 国民党与民众党因新竹县竹北市市长候选人提名问题谈判破裂，双方各自推举人选。这一分歧可能削弱两党间脆弱的信任，并影响其在2028年大选中的合作前景。
items.whyImportant: 反对党阵营的内部分裂可能改变台湾地方选举格局，并对未来的政治联盟产生深远影响。

items.title: After 66 years, Kau Kee’s first shop offers fish balls ‘every Hongkonger has eaten’
items.summary: Anita Lee Yan-kwan grew up around a traditional business that supplied fish balls to Hong Kong’s street food stalls and eateries. But for decades, Kau Kee Food Factory’s signature product was known only among industry operators until Lee, a second-generation owner, opened the company’s first retail store late last year. Kau Kee has operated as a silent giant in the food industry for 66 years, supplying its fish balls to nearly 1,000 eateries and snack stalls across the city. But it finally...
items.titleZh: 经营66年后，九记首家门店推出“每个香港人都吃过”的鱼蛋
items.summaryZh: 九记食品厂长期作为香港餐饮业的幕后供应商，为近千家食肆提供鱼蛋。第二代经营者李恩群于去年底开设了公司首家零售店，将这一传统品牌推向大众市场。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着香港传统老字号从批发模式向零售模式转型，以适应市场变化。

items.title: Chinese food delivery platform sparks buzz after rider flies to Singapore for curry puff run
items.summary: A Chinese man dressed in a food delivery uniform has sparked widespread curiosity online after he was seen in Singapore buying curry puffs for a customer in China to fulfil a “cross-border food order.” On August 31, Chloe, a Chinese woman living in Singapore, shared a video depicting the man in a Meituan uniform waiting at Hong Lim Curry Puff, a snack shop located in PLQ Mall, about a 17-minute drive from Changi Airport. Meituan is among China’s largest food delivery platforms. Chloe informed...
items.titleZh: 中国外卖平台骑手飞往新加坡购买咖喱角引发热议
items.summaryZh: 一名身穿美团制服的男子在新加坡购买咖喱角，据称是为了满足中国客户的“跨境食品订单”。这一视频在社交媒体上引发了广泛关注与好奇。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对于跨境物流服务边界及网络营销真实性的讨论。

items.title: Why are fuel and petrochemical prices outpacing crude – and how long will it last?
items.summary: This summer, David Chen, a Chinese national living in Japan, got an unexpected lesson in global industrial supply chains – delivered through a bag of potato chips. When popular Japanese snack brand Calbee replaced its signature colourful packaging with monochrome designs, Chen initially assumed it was a marketing gimmick. “Then news reports explained the switch stemmed from a naphtha supply crunch. I even looked up the word,” Chen said. Naphtha, a flammable liquid processed from crude oil, might...
items.titleZh: 为何燃料和石化产品价格涨幅超过原油？这种情况会持续多久？
items.summaryZh: 日本零食品牌卡乐比因石化原料石脑油供应紧张而被迫更改包装设计。石脑油作为原油加工产品，其供应短缺已波及全球工业供应链。
items.whyImportant: 石化产品供应链的波动揭示了全球工业生产对特定原材料的高度依赖及其连锁反应。

items.title: Why the EU is giving Arctic shipping the cold shoulder as China and Russia push ahead
items.summary: As Beijing and Moscow double down on the Arctic shipping route, Europe is hitting the brakes. Despite being the main destination for goods along the route and accounting for most of the world’s shipping giants, Europe opposes the commercialisation of Arctic transits, wary of fragile polar ecosystems and navigational risks amid rising anxiety over Russia and China’s closer polar collaboration. “In Europe, cooperation between China and Russia on container shipping is often viewed as another...
items.titleZh: 为何欧盟对北极航线持冷淡态度，而中俄却积极推进？
items.summaryZh: 尽管欧洲是北极航线的主要目的地，但出于对生态环境和航行风险的担忧，欧洲反对北极航线的商业化。同时，欧洲对中俄在北极航运上的合作表现出警惕。
items.whyImportant: 北极航线的开发涉及地缘政治博弈、环境保护与全球贸易路线的重塑。

items.title: Is Russia proving better at protecting friends than fighting enemies in West Africa?
items.summary: Russian forces were brought in to help defeat jihadists but they also defend the military leadership in Niger.
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯在西非是保护盟友比打击敌人更有效吗？
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯军队进入尼日尔旨在打击圣战分子，但其主要作用也包括保护当地的军事领导层。外界质疑其在反恐与维护政权稳定之间的侧重点。
items.whyImportant: 该问题揭示了俄罗斯在非洲地区军事干预的复杂动机及其对当地政治格局的影响。

items.title: Investigations launched into polling firm at centre of Reform UK allegations
items.summary: British Polling Council and Market Research Society announce inquiries into JL Partners, which has been accused of breaking transparency rules What is the latest finance scandal facing Reform UK? A polling firm at the centre of allegations that Reform UK breached electoral law is being investigated by two industry bodies. JL Partners, which is run by former Conservative aides, has been accused of breaking transparency rules by failing to declare that three separate polls had been commissioned by the party. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 针对卷入英国改革党指控的民调公司展开调查
items.summaryZh: 英国民调委员会和市场研究协会正对JL Partners公司展开调查。该公司被指控在未披露委托方的情况下，为英国改革党进行了三次民调，违反了透明度规则。
items.whyImportant: 此调查涉及选举公正性和民调行业的透明度问题，可能对英国政治舆论环境产生影响。

items.title: Russia strikes Ukraine intelligence HQ in ‘major escalation’
items.summary: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he has told SBU to deliver ‘appropriate, tangible response’ to Kyiv strike The head office of Ukraine’s SBU intelligence agency has been hit in a Russian drone attack, sending plumes of black smoke rising into the air in the heart of Kyiv. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said he had instructed the SBU to deliver an “appropriate, tangible response” to the strike, while the foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, described it as a “major escalation”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰情报总部，局势“重大升级”
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯无人机袭击了位于基辅市中心的乌克兰国家安全局总部。乌克兰总统泽连斯基已下令进行“实质性回应”，乌外长称此举为局势的重大升级。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击直接针对乌克兰核心情报机构，标志着俄乌冲突在打击目标和烈度上的进一步升级。
